title: Superman: The Animated Series
description: Superman protects Metropolis and Earth from powerful threats while balancing his life as reporter Clark Kent.

episodes.title: Fun and Games
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E04 - Fun and Games (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Gangster Bruno Mannheim is running into problems with the mysterious Toyman , who uses children's toys and games to cause violence. After being abducted by Toyman, Lois learns his motivation: his father had taken a loan from Mannheim and was set up to take the fall when the police busted one of Mannheim's criminal enterprises. [ 4 ]

episodes.title: A Little Piece of Home
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E05 - A Little Piece of Home (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: During the opening of a museum, Superman tries to stop two robbers, but fails after falling victim to the poisoning effects of Kryptonite , one of the exhibited rocks. Lex Luthor sees the surveillance tape of the event and determines that this must be Superman's weakness. Luthor orchestrates a scheme to trap Superman and kill him using Kryptonite. [ 5 ]

episodes.title: Feeding Time
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E06 - Feeding Time (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Janitor Rudy Jones runs into an accident with stolen chemical barrels and becomes Parasite . He feeds on the energy of others, with his number one choice being Superman. In doing so, he discovers Superman's identity. [ 6 ]

episodes.title: The Way of All Flesh
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E07 - The Way of All Flesh (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Thanks to the orchestrations of Luthor, terrorist John Corben becomes Metallo , a cyborg with a Kryptonite heart. Luthor then sets the supervillain on a quest to kill Superman, but Corben begins to question his role as Metallo as he lacks any human senses. [ 7 ]

episodes.title: Stolen Memories
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E08 - Stolen Memories (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Brainiac comes to Earth as part of his information-gathering trek across the galaxy, and partners with Lex Luthor on the basis of giving technological progress to humanity. But, as Superman discovers, Brainiac intends to destroy Earth after gathering all of its knowledge. [ 8 ]

episodes.title: The Main Man, Part 1
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E09 - The Main Man, Part 1 of 2 (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4

episodes.title: The Main Man, Part 2
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E10 - The Main Man, Part 2 of 2 (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4

episodes.title: My Girl
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E11 - My Girl (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Clark's high school sweetheart Lana Lang , who is now a famous fashion designer, comes to Metropolis where she and Lex Luthor become a celebrity couple. Lana still has strong feelings for Clark, and additionally deduced his secret identity long ago. Hoping to become his sidekick (and lover), she puts her own life in danger by spying on Luthor's arms sales to gain incriminating information. [ 11 ]

episodes.title: Tools of the Trade
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E12 - Tools of the Trade (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Bruno Mannheim's Intergang terrorizes Metropolis with hi-tech weapons from a mysterious backer (Darkseid's minion Kanto ), while SCU inspector Dan Turpin goes on a personal hunt for answers. Turpin has been the subject of media jokes that Superman must do everything, until Superman appears on camera saying it was actually Turpin who saved Superman's life by stopping one of the deadly weapons. In the end, Mannheim meets his new boss, the evil lord Darkseid . [ 12 ]

episodes.title: Two's a Crowd
episodes.file: Season 1 (1996-97)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S01 E13 - Two's a Crowd (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: When embittered scientist Earl Garver goes into a coma before revealing the location of a ticking bomb, Superman risks enlisting the Parasite to drain the information from Garver's mind. However, the operation goes awry when Garver's consciousness ends up in Parasite's body, leaving the two fighting for control. [ 13 ]

episodes.title: Blasts from the Past, Part 1
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E01 - Blasts from the Past, Part 1 of 2 (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4

episodes.title: Blasts from the Past, Part 2
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E02 - Blasts from the Past, Part 2 of 2 (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4

episodes.title: The Prometheon
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E03 - The Prometheon (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: During a mission in space, Superman discovers a massive humanoid stone giant named the Prometheon latched to an asteroid. The Prometheon breaks loose and plummets to Metropolis. It causes devastation and accumulates energy by sucking up heat from firepower and power plants. [ 16 ]

episodes.title: Speed Demons
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E04 - Speed Demons (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Superman and Flash compete in a charity running race around the world to determine who truly is the fastest man alive. Meanwhile, a menace called the Weather Wizard harnesses enough power to create devastating storms across the globe, deriving energy from special armbands attached to Superman and Flash. The two heroes, after discovering this, put their race on hold to stop him. [ 17 ]

episodes.title: Livewire
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E05 - Livewire (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Leslie Willis, an obnoxious shock jock and critic of Superman, holds a rock concert during a thunderstorm , but is struck by lightning and transformed into the electric villainess Livewire . Superman must defeat her before she sucks the city dry of electricity. [ 18 ]

episodes.title: Identity Crisis
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E06 - Identity Crisis (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Superman encounters a clone of himself who decays into a flawed version dubbed Bizarro . The clone continuously claims to be the true Superman until discovering the truth of his origins — a secret cloning operation led by Lex Luthor, who hopes to create an army of Supermen at his disposal. [ 19 ]

episodes.title: Target
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E07 - Target (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Lois finds herself marked for death by stalker and former LexCorp employee Edward Lytener. Superman saves her a few times from the murderous attempts, but he cannot protect her 24/7. [ 20 ]

episodes.title: Mxyzpixilated
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E08 - Mxyzpixilated (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: A powerful fifth-dimensional imp named Mister Mxyzptlk starts annoying Superman by appearing every 90 days to cause trouble and mischief. However, he becomes equally aggravated because Superman repeatedly tricks him into saying, spelling or revealing his own name backward, sending him back to the 5th dimension. Mxyzptlk returns with a proposition for Superman—get him to say or spell his own name backward twice in a row, and he will leave Superman alone forever. [ 21 ]

episodes.title: Action Figures
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E09 - Action Figures (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: An amnesiac Metallo reemerges from the ocean and washes ashore on a volcanic island, where two children find and befriend him. As Metallo gradually regains his memories, he becomes evil again and seeks revenge on Superman. [ 22 ]

episodes.title: Double Dose
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E10 - Double Dose (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Livewire escapes from prison, eager to punish Superman for placing her there. She teams up with Parasite to cause mayhem once again. [ 23 ]

episodes.title: Solar Power
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E11 - Solar Power (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Edward Lytener returns as Luminus to seek revenge against Superman, depowering him by hacking Luthor's satellites to make Earth's sunlight red. He ties up and gags Jimmy and Lois and uses them as bait for Superman, who finally saves them. [ 24 ]

episodes.title: Brave New Metropolis
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E12 - Brave New Metropolis (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: After an accident with a portal at S.T.A.R. Labs , Lois is transported to a parallel universe where she was killed while investigating Intergang, causing Superman to join forces with Lex Luthor to create a police state of control. When Lois learns how much Superman cared for her, she desperately seeks a way back home so she can share her true feelings for him as well. [ 25 ]

episodes.title: Monkey Fun
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E13 - Monkey Fun (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: A chimpanzee is found floating in space, returning from years of suspended animation in his ship. It turns out the chimpanzee, named Titano , was a beloved companion of Lois during her childhood. In space, Titano encountered a radioactive asteroid, causing him to mutate and grow drastically in size, becoming big trouble for Superman and Metropolis. [ 17 ] [ 26 ]

episodes.title: Ghost in the Machine
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E14 - Ghost in the Machine (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Brainiac takes control of LexCorp 's computer systems and traps Luthor in his own laboratory, forcing him to rebuild Brainiac's primary body in secret. After Clark questions why Lex is missing from his office, Superman and Mercy Graves team up to investigate his disappearance. [ 27 ]

episodes.title: Father's Day
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E15 - Father's Day (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: To curry his father's favor, the New God brute Kalibak goes to Earth to destroy Superman. Meanwhile, Jonathan and Martha Kent are visiting Superman in Metropolis for Father's Day. The city takes a beating as the two sons battle it out.

episodes.title: World's Finest, Part 1
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E16 - World's Finest, Part 1 of 3 (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4

episodes.title: World's Finest, Part 2
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E17 - World's Finest, Part 2 of 3 (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4

episodes.title: World's Finest, Part 3
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E18 - World's Finest, Part 3 of 3 (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4

episodes.title: The Hand of Fate
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E19 - The Hand of Fate (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: When an evil demon named Karkull is unleashed, Superman attempts to enlist the aid of the now uninterested wizard superhero, Doctor Fate . [ 30 ]

episodes.title: Bizarro's World
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E20 - Bizarro's World (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Bizarro, after discovering Superman's Fortress of Solitude , sees the demise of Krypton. Believing this is his own past, Bizarro constructs a "Krypton" in downtown Metropolis with the intent to destroy it in the same manner that Krypton was. [ 29 ]

episodes.title: Prototype
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E21 - Prototype (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: LexCorp and John Henry Irons design a powerful prototype armor for the Metropolis SCU, which Lex hopes will make Superman's services unneeded. The SCU officer who pilots the suit, Sergeant Mills, proves a useful partner to Superman at first, but the suit soon corrupts the officer's mind, making him violently unstable. Irons is discouraged over the failure of his project, but Superman convinces him that it would be a valuable tool if he can find a way to stabilize it. [ 31 ]

episodes.title: The Late Mr. Kent
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E22 - The Late Mr. Kent (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Clark Kent has evidence to clear a condemned man from a death sentence, but the situation complicates when Superman survives a murder attempt on Clark planned by dirty cop Detective Bowman. Superman does not want to sacrifice his dual identity, but he does not want an innocent man to be killed for a crime he did not commit. The investigative episode ends with a twist, plus a certain character's shocking realization. [ 32 ]

episodes.title: Heavy Metal
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E23 - Heavy Metal (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: John Henry Irons, an ex-employee of LexCorp , has been developing a new, advanced suit for himself. When Superman is caught off guard from the reappearance of Metallo, Irons must suit up as Steel to help Superman. [ 33 ]

episodes.title: Warrior Queen
episodes.file: Season 2 (1997-98)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S02 E24 - Warrior Queen (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Maxima , the stuck-up queen of an alien empire, discovers her perfect mate: Superman. She takes Superman back to her native planet only to learn she has been deposed due to public outrage against her. [ 34 ]

episodes.title: Where There's Smoke
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E01 - Where There's Smoke (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Superman crosses paths with a fiery-tempered, metahuman thief named Volcana . She possesses pyrokinetic abilities and is on the run from a secret government agency. With the help of a telekinetic psychologist, Superman hopes to locate and help the misguided Volcana. [ 39 ]

episodes.title: Knight Time
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E02 - Knight Time (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Superman learns from Roxy Rocket that Batman has been missing from Gotham for some time now. Superman finds Robin , who has been battling all the crimes in Batman's absence, and rogues such as The Penguin, The Riddler, Bane, The Mad Hatter and Roxy Rocket. Disguised as Batman, Superman helps Robin investigate why his partner has disappeared, leading up to a confrontation with Brainiac. [ 40 ]

episodes.title: New Kids in Town
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E03 - New Kids in Town (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: It is the 30th century and Brainiac travels back in time to destroy Clark Kent before he can become Superman. Three Legionnaires from the future - Saturn Girl , Cosmic Boy , and Chameleon Boy - travel back in time to help Clark fight Brainiac. [ 41 ]

episodes.title: Obsession
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E04 - Obsession (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Lana Lang is in Metropolis managing a series of fashion shows featuring the latest top model, Darci. When an attempt is made to kidnap her, Superman discovers the kidnapping was organized by Toyman, who is obsessed with Darci. Both Superman and Lang suspect the model knows more than she is letting on, and discover she hides a secret behind her origins. This would later be followed by the Static Shock episode "Toys in the Hood". [ 42 ]

episodes.title: Little Big Head Man
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E05 - Little Big Head Man (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Mister Mxyzptlk returns and tricks Bizarro into attacking Superman. He must use both brawn and intellect to fight the formidable duo. [ 43 ]

episodes.title: Absolute Power
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E06 - Absolute Power (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Jax-Ur and Mala have escaped the Phantom Zone and subjugated an entire planet, dubbed New Krypton. After rescuing a distraught spaceship from a black hole, Superman stumbles upon New Krypton. At first, he feels he should leave Jax-Ur and Mala alone to rule as they please, but he reconsiders when he sees they are secretly creating a navy with the intent of attacking Earth. [ 44 ]

episodes.title: In Brightest Day
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E07 - In Brightest Day (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Abin Sur , a member of the Green Lantern Corps dies after crash-landing on Earth and passes his ring on to Daily Planet artist Kyle Rayner , who becomes the next Green Lantern . With Superman's help, Kyle learns the power of the ring and quickly becomes a valuable partner. They work together to battle the power-hungry, ruthless opponent Sinestro . [ 45 ]

episodes.title: Superman's Pal
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E08 - Superman's Pal (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Jimmy Olsen garners unwanted attention after news reporter Angela Chen dubs him "Superman's Pal". Jimmy soon runs into more trouble than usual, so Superman must come to his rescue more often. Meanwhile, Jimmy has begun dating a young Daily Planet intern, who has a "thing" for metal. She uses Jimmy to lure Superman into a trap—a confrontation with Metallo. [ 46 ]

episodes.title: A Fish Story
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E09 - A Fish Story (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Creatures of the sea are acting in strange and aggressive ways lately. It turns out Lex Luthor is undergoing an unethical, underwater experiment and has also imprisoned the legendary Aquaman . Lois and Clark must help Aquaman before a war breaks out between Earth and Atlantis . [ 47 ]

episodes.title: Unity
episodes.file: Season 3 (1998-99)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S03 E10 - Unity (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Superman and Supergirl must save Smallville, and the world, from the Reverend, a gargantuan scouting probe disguised as a human reverend named Powell, as well as its master, an even larger alien parasite that wishes to unite Earth's inhabitants in perpetual unity. [ 48 ]

episodes.title: The Demon Reborn
episodes.file: Season 4 (1999-00)/SUPERMAN T.A.S. - S04 E01 - The Demon Reborn (720p - HMax Web-DL).mp4
episodes.description: Ra's al Ghul and his Society of Shadows arrive in Metropolis to steal a mythical staff currently on exhibit. Ra's is dying as the Lazarus Pits can no longer heal him, and wants to use the staff to steal Superman's powers and sustain himself. It is up to Batman to locate and rescue Superman from the immortal foe.
